messages:
sam.dev: Heads up — prepping prod push for release 2026.3. Deploy bot shows guardian approval required. Change window 02:00-04:00 UTC, canary planned at 10%. tagging @toni @alex for approvals.

deploy-bot: request received: deploy/2026.3. Blocker: role 'prod-deployer' MFA revalidation required (token age > 30d). To continue run `/deploy approve 2499954321` after JIT. Logs: https://deploy.redwood/req/2499954321

toni: I can approve but need assurance: no DB migrations and no schema changes? also please paste the quick audit link.

sam.dev: No DB changes — purely runtime model pin (model-service: v3.2.1 -> v3.3.0). Canary already passed staging smoke. Audit: https://audit.redwood/tx/54321. No long-running queries expected.

alex: FYI I just got a new phone and haven't re-registered MFA. Can someone trigger a JIT for me? prefer not to use breakglass.

maria: Oncall here — use `auth-jit request --role prod-deployer --reason "release 2026.3" --expiry 1h` (https://id.redwood/jit). Ping me when the token is issued and I'll validate the request and approve. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: JIT token issued to alex (45m expiry). Audit snapshot attached. Approval pending from @toni or @maria. Token id: jit-7a3f.

toni: Reviewed audit and smoke. Approved at 2499954360. Note: make sure canary traffic is throttled to 10% for 20m before promoting. :white_check_mark:

sam.dev: Roger. Starting canary deployment now. Will post metrics in 20m.

--- 18 minutes later ---

sam.dev: Canary looks clean (latency and error budget fine). Promoting to 100%. Thanks for the quick approvals. :rocket:

maria: Noted — reminder to revoke any JIT tokens after deploy and rotate temporary keys. I'll close the approval ticket once confirmed. :lock:

sam.dev: Done — revoked jit-7a3f and added note in release notes. https://confluence.redwood/release/2026.3/notes

deploy-bot: deploy/2026.3 completed successfully. Rollback pin: model-service@v3.2.1 available. If rollback needed run `/deploy rollback model-service v3.2.1`

sam.dev: Thanks all — leaving thread for postmortem only if rollback needed.
